# What should our wellness plan cost, and what happens if members use more than we planned?

> Free calculator for veterinary practices: price an in-house wellness plan. Monthly fee for your target margin, margin if members use more than planned, patient savings and yearly plan profit. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
